specInfoTitle: VMware Cloud Foundation API Reference Guide

derivation.kind: focused projection of the pinned OpenAPI JSON
notes: Every operationId, HTTP method, path, success status, member name, required-member list, readOnly-member list and enumerated value in docs/contract.json was read out of the JSON document at the specUrl above, at the JSON pointers recorded here. No rendered documentation page is a contract source.

The 9.1.0.0 revision of the same file (tag 9.1.0.0, commit 3949fc33339fc5ea1b77eadb258f1cf49aa88e26) is deliberately NOT the source. Among the schemas this contract projects, 9.1.0.0 differs from 9.0.0.0 in ResourceCredentials.resourceType, whose enumerated values grow from ESXI, VCENTER, PSC, NSXT_MANAGER, NSXT_EDGE, NSX_ALB, BACKUP to additionally include HCX_MANAGER and VSP. A client pinned to 9.0.0.0 must refuse those two values.

The 202 response of updateOrRotatePasswords is Task, not CredentialsTask: /paths/~1v1~1credentials/patch/responses/202/content/application~1json/schema/$ref resolves to #/components/schemas/Task. The polled representation at getCredentialsTask is CredentialsTask. The two schemas carry different status vocabularies and only CredentialsTask carries subTasks with per-resource oldPassword and newPassword members.

The 9.0.0.0 document declares no components.securitySchemes and no global security requirement, so the Authorization: Bearer header this contract requires is a deployment convention of SDDC Manager pinned by docs/contract.json and the shipped mock. It is not presented as a claim derived from the specification.
